scope: explicit immutable frozen Dream House operator board export

checks.name: export, board, view, envelope, and CLI focused tests
all component House test suites
checks.command: for test_dir in $(find house -type d -name tests -print | sort); do python3 -m unittest discover -s "$test_dir" -p 'test_*.py'; done

checks.name: static checks
checks.command: python3 -m compileall -q house/relay && ruff check changed files && ruff format --check changed files && git diff --check

claim_ceiling: An explicit local writer and verifier for one caller-supplied frozen operator board plus a companion integrity receipt. It does not discover/refresh sources, run inventory, scan paths, overwrite/replace/clean up data, apply retention, read live task/relay state, bind a listener, start a viewer, launch a browser, call iTerm, accept terminal input, create/mutate/dispatch tasks, contact workers/providers, grant authority, or open a reverse channel.
